# Lemmo Documentation

> Lemmo is an integrated AI creative suite bridging generative AI models with an infinite interactive canvas. This index provides structured references to the system architecture, design tokens, frontend, backend, branding, and DevOps standards.

## Architecture & Core System Rules

- [ADR-004: Proposed Backend Service and Tenant Boundaries](01-architecture/decisions/adr-004-backend-microservices.md): Decision record for independent backend services, tenant/project authorization and durable AI execution based on ratified backend specifications.
- [ADR-005: Frontend Styling Strategy with Tailwind CSS v4 in app/](01-architecture/decisions/ADR-005-tailwind-v4-styling-strategy.md): Authoritative decision locking Tailwind CSS v4 as the official styling strategy for app/, superseding CSS Modules.
- [ADR-006: Auth Gateway Scope and Deferred Component System Integration](01-architecture/decisions/ADR-006-auth-gateway-and-deferred-components.md): Designates auth/ as the sole system authentication gateway and defers shared component system integration until after backend-frontend connectivity.
- [ADR-007: Backend Contracts, Scaffolding Tooling, and Core Interface Standards](01-architecture/decisions/ADR-007-backend-contracts-and-tooling-standards.md): Ratified decision locking centralized error catalog, canonical Protobuf node contracts, Go scaffolding CLI, and core auth/quota interfaces.
- [ADR-008: Internal Tooling Directory, Multi-Module SemVer, and Changelog Standards](01-architecture/decisions/ADR-008-internal-tooling-and-versioning-governance.md): Ratified decision establishing tools/ as single home for internal tooling, finalizing tools/lemmo-cli for scaffolding, SemVer 2.0.0, multi-module git tags, and Keep a Changelog.
- [ADR-009: Service-Owned Deployment Boundary and Financial Ledger Architecture](01-architecture/decisions/ADR-009-service-owned-deployment-and-financial-ledger.md): Architectural decision establishing service-owned deployment boundaries via Docker Compose include, role-based infrastructure naming (financial-ledger), FinancialLedgerPort abstraction, and configuration-driven parameters.
- [ADR-010: Workspace Service Architecture, Multi-Tenancy Governance, and Phase 1 Milestone Gate 5 Acceptance](01-architecture/decisions/ADR-010-workspace-service-and-phase1-completion.md): Ratified architectural decision for workspace-service, lemmo_workspace database schema with on_wallet_empty, provisioning state pattern for wallet creation, dual-adapter IAM permission manager, configurable invitation TTL, and 9-step E2E integration test closing Phase 1.
- [ADR-011: Business Capabilities Architecture (Promo, Novu Notifications, Affiliate vs Referral, Social Feed, User Onboarding)](01-architecture/decisions/ADR-011-business-capabilities-and-phase2-roadmap.md): Ratified architecture for commercial capabilities: dual promo engine, Novu notification infrastructure, referral vs affiliate separation, community-service social feed, and user onboarding state machine.
- [ADR-012: Reference Data Registry Pattern & Client-Side Invalidation Cache](01-architecture/decisions/ADR-012-reference-data-registry-and-client-cache.md): Establishes the authoritative Reference Data Registry service, client-side dual-tier cache (memory+disk) with RabbitMQ invalidation events, audit logs, and Stage 10A/10B split.
- [Configuration & Secret Management Strategy](01-architecture/configuration-and-secrets.md): Authoritative system-wide strategy for configuration and secrets management, establishing three-tier variable classification, strict fail-fast policies, zero hardcoded constants, and versioned YAML configs.
- [Documentation Agent Rules & Zero-Contradiction Governance](09-governance/rules.md): Binding operational rules, strict zero-contradiction policy, and STOP protocol for AI agents modifying the Lemmo documentation repo.
- [Lemmo Documentation Guidelines & Single Source of Truth (SSOT)](index.md): Central index, folder governance, authoring standards, and architectural blueprints for Lemmo.
- [Lemmo Frontend Rules & Agent Constraints](01-architecture/AGENTS.md): Mandatory engineering constraints, import boundaries, token rules, and coding standards for developers and AI agents.
- [Platform Security Audit, Threat Catalog & Systematic Hardening Roadmap](01-architecture/security-audit-and-remediation.md): Exhaustive catalog and remediation blueprint for 22 platform security findings (2 P0, 13 P1, 7 P2) identified in the October 2026 security audit. Organizes vulnerabilities into four targeted hardening workstreams: Edge Ingress & Identity, Multi-Tenant Authorization & Assets, Financial Ledger Concurrency & Idempotency, and Operational Defense.
- [Request Context Governance, Workspace Policy Classification, and End-to-End Lifecycle Security](01-architecture/decisions/ADR-016-request-context-governance-and-workspace-policy.md): Formalizes request context lifecycle and multi-tenancy isolation across Edge Gateway and Studio SDK: amends ADR-013 Section 2.3 by eliminating blanket fallback for workspace-scoped operations, introduces contract-driven policy classification (x-lemmo-workspace-policy: required/optional/none), mandates client transport header sanitization, context freezing across retries, context-service infrastructure error disambiguation (503 vs empty memberships), a 6-state Studio Context Provider machine, tenant-isolated TanStack Query cache management, and cross-boundary live verification tests.
- [Three-Tier Edge Gateway & BFF Architecture](01-architecture/decisions/ADR-013-three-tier-edge-gateway-and-bff-architecture.md): Architectural decision establishing a 3-tier perimeter ingress: Declarative Kong edge gateway, Ory Oathkeeper identity proxy translating Kratos sessions to short-lived JWTs, and a stateless Go context-service for UI-only aggregated context.
- [Unified Identity Architecture, Automatic Registration/Login Flow & Zero-Trust Session Lifecycle](01-architecture/decisions/ADR-015-unified-identity-auth-flow-and-session-lifecycle.md): Ratification of the live identity architecture inspired by NONS: Passwordless 6-digit OTP (Magic Code), minimal Kratos identity schema (email-only), unified entry flow with Admin API pre-check preventing duplicate identifier crashes, Edge Gateway route partitioning without forward-auth on self-service, real-time logout revocation via Redis timestamp in lemmo-access-enforcer (single MGET pipeline), and deep-link return_to preservation.

## Design System & Tokens

- [AI Design Decision Principles & Judgment Framework](04-design-system/design-decision-principles.md): Functional decision-making rules, relational spacing, typography scales, animation budgets, and UX patterns guiding AI models beyond raw tokens.
- [Agent-Operable Interfaces & Accessibility Tree Architecture](04-design-system/agent-operable-interfaces.md): Designing interfaces operable by AI agents via the accessibility tree, Name/Role/Value triad, stable Playwright locators, WebMCP standard, and race-condition prevention.
- [Assistive Technology, Micro-States & Error Handling Principles](04-design-system/assistive-technology-and-microstates.md): WCAG 1.4.13 hover/focus standards, accessible alt text and labels, skeleton vs spinner loading guidelines, ARIA live regions, and structured error/empty states.
- [Color Tokens, Semantic Palette & Contrast Audit](04-design-system/color.md): Color tokens, dark theme specification, brand accents, status colors, and WCAG AA contrast compliance.
- [Container Relationship Styling & Inheritance Architecture](04-design-system/container-relationship-and-inheritance.md): Concentric border-radius mathematical formula, container padding custom properties, three-tier token inheritance, and density synchronization to eliminate hardcoded child styles.
- [Design System Style Guide & Implementation Standards](04-design-system/STYLEGUIDE.md): Executive summary and mandatory rules for token consumption, colors, typography, spacing, and accessibility.
- [Iconography Standards & Synthline Rules](04-design-system/iconography.md): Synthline icon set specification, sizing ladder (12-28px), stroke-width rules, and accessibility guidelines.
- [Responsive Decision Principles & Algorithmic Layout Framework](04-design-system/responsive-decision-principles.md): Algorithmic and composable layout design principles, puzzle grid column scaling, responsive image rules, carousel constraints, Priority+ navigation, and back-button behaviors across viewport sizes.
- [Typography, Font Stacks & Type Scale Rules](04-design-system/typography.md): Typography specifications, font loading (Satoshi, Oddval), type scale ladder, and language switching rules.
- [UI/UX Design System Guidelines: Direction, Layout, Responsive & Interaction Principles](04-design-system/interaction-and-layout.md): Comprehensive framework for logical layout, Start/End directionality, directional vs non-directional icons, action hierarchy, dropdown behaviors, progressive reduction, and decision rules.

## Brand Identity & Visual Guidelines

- [Brand Identity & Visual Assets Guide](05-branding/index.md): Guidelines for brand logo mark, 3-dot triad, typography, color philosophy, and asset files.
- [Brand Logo Mark, Icon Assets & Usage Rules](04-design-system/logo.md): Geometry, 3-dot triad mark, color variations, sizes, SVG assets, and prohibited usages of Lemmo logo.

## Frontend Engineering

- [Frontend Architecture & Engineering Guidelines](02-frontend/index.md): Central index for frontend architecture, state management, routing, and coding conventions.
- [Workspace Architectural Decisions: Plugin System, SDK Gateway & Job Manager](02-frontend/workspace-decisions.md): Detailed architectural decisions for the Lemmo Workspace covering schema-driven tool plugins, central SDK gateway, and global AI job management.
- [Workspace Frontend Architecture — Next.js](02-frontend/workspace-architecture.md): Finalized dependency rules, directory structure, and modular boundaries for the Lemmo Next.js workspace.
- [Workspace Satellite Projects, Shared Resources & Dependencies](02-frontend/workspace-dependencies.md): Guide and reference for peripheral monorepo projects, font assets, token engines, documentation, and the Synthline icon package used in the Lemmo Workspace app.

## Backend & API Specifications

- [Backend Architecture & Engineering Specifications](03-backend/index.md): Central index for backend microservices monorepo architecture, service catalog, contracts, and style guide.
- [Backend Microservices Monorepo Architecture](03-backend/architecture.md): Canonical architecture of lemmo-api monorepo: directory layout, service independence, service-owned deployment, role-based naming (ADR-009), core libraries, infra, and scaling.
- [Backend Style Guide & Engineering Standards](03-backend/style-guide.md): Authoritative Go source formatting, golangci-lint, package layout, error envelope, protobuf, and migration rules.
- [Contracts, Schemas and Event Envelope Governance](03-backend/contracts.md): Specification for contracts/ directory, platform and lemmo protos, JSON schemas, event envelopes, and code generation.
- [Credit Economy, Flat Pricing, Rate Card & Ledger Architecture](03-backend/credit-and-ledger.md): Comprehensive specification for Flat pricing model, Rate Card, pre-execution cost estimation, 19-field immutable Credit Ledger, Bucket expiry model, Payer Policy, and service architecture.
- [Entitlements, Storage Quotas, Retention & Access Governance](03-backend/entitlements-and-iam.md): Authoritative specification for IAM Entitlement Grants, machine-readable plan matrix, storage quotas, retention policies, over-quota lifecycle, team credit pooling, gateway rate limiting, and promo/referral governance per ADR-011.
- [Microservices Catalog & Phased Delivery Roadmap](03-backend/services.md): Complete breakdown of nons reused services, Lemmo specific microservices, service anatomy, and phased delivery roadmap.
- [Multi-Provider Model Routing, Media Pipelines & Execution Architecture](03-backend/media-and-model-pipeline.md): Comprehensive architecture for cloud model routing, 4-layer provider registry, generic REST adapters, 3-level fallback, token bucket rate limiting, and async media pipeline.
- [Unified Backend Phased Roadmap, Milestone Gates & Service Execution Plan](03-backend/roadmap.md): Canonical, unified backend and platform engineering roadmap: consolidates granular Phase 0 skeleton, Phase 1 MVP services (Stages 1-9, closed Gates 0-5), Phase 2 Live Identity, Gateway & Studio SDK Integration (Stages 10A, 10B, 10.5, 11, and Stage 12A/12B per ADR-016), Phase 3 Commercialization (Stages 14-16), and Phase 4 Ecosystem (Stages 17-19) with explicit quality gates and development conventions.

## DevOps, CI/CD & Infrastructure

- [DevOps, CI/CD Pipelines & Docker Infrastructure Guide](07-devops/index.md): Authoritative guide for Docker-centric hosting, deployment, multi-stage builds, Docker Compose orchestration, and CI/CD pipelines.
- [Docker Naming Conventions, Tagging Standards & Build Hygiene](07-devops/docker-spec.md): Authoritative specification for Docker image and container naming, container_name conventions, immutable tagging, prevention of duplicate/stale images, and build provenance logging.

## Feature Modules & Components

- [Canvas Dual-Mode Architecture & Dynamic Node Port Specifications](06-modules/canvas-modes.md): Architectural specification for Canvas Dual-Mode (Free Design Mode vs Paid Workflow Mode), dynamic and extensible node port schemas, and unhardcoded LoRA/Prompt variable socket configurations.
- [Lemmo Product Proposal & Functional Overview](proposal.md): Comprehensive functional product proposal describing what Lemmo is, its core capabilities, visual canvas workflow, specialized creative tool engine, and practical user journeys without technical jargon.
- [Workspace Feature Modules & Domain Logic Overview](06-modules/index.md): Overview of domain modules in the Lemmo workspace including tool-engine, chat, canvas, gallery, assets, and billing.

## Project Roadmap & Milestone Audits

- [Roadmap Reprioritization: Core Identity, Client Integration, Tooling & IAM Engine First](01-architecture/decisions/ADR-014-roadmap-reprioritization-core-identity-and-client-integration.md): Strategic realignment of the backend roadmap: Prioritizing live user registration/login (auth-service/Kratos), automated OpenAPI tooling, full frontend SDK integration (app/ live adapter), and fine-grained authorization (iam-service) before peripheral monetization and notification modules.
